SET search_path TO vulnerability_management;
SELECT id, cve_id, configurations, cvss_v3_base_score, cvss_v3_severity
FROM vulnerability_management.cves
WHERE status = 'unprocessed'
  AND published_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '26 hours'
ORDER BY id

SET search_path TO vulnerability_management;
SELECT id, cpe_uri, vendor, product, version, asset_name, criticality, exposed_to_internet
FROM vulnerability_management.software_inventory
ORDER BY id

SET search_path TO vulnerability_management;
INSERT INTO vulnerability_management.applicable_vulnerabilities
  (cve_id, software_id, correlation_confidence)
VALUES ({{ $json.cve_db_id }}, {{ $json.software_id }}, '{{ $json.correlation_confidence }}')
ON CONFLICT (cve_id, software_id) DO NOTHING

SET search_path TO vulnerability_management;
UPDATE vulnerability_management.cves
SET status = 'correlated'
WHERE status = 'unprocessed'
  AND '{{ $json.processedCveDbIds }}' <> ''
  AND id = ANY(string_to_array('{{ $json.processedCveDbIds }}', ',')::int[])

SET search_path TO vulnerability_management;
INSERT INTO vulnerability_management.audit_log
  (workflow_name, execution_id, status, records_processed, executed_at)
VALUES ('workflow-correlation', '{{ $execution.id }}', 'SUCCESS', {{ $json.correlationsInserted }}, NOW())

SET search_path TO vulnerability_management;
UPDATE vulnerability_management.cves
SET status = 'correlated'
WHERE status = 'unprocessed'
  AND '{{ $json.processedCveDbIds }}' <> ''
  AND id = ANY(string_to_array('{{ $json.processedCveDbIds }}', ',')::int[])

SET search_path TO vulnerability_management;
INSERT INTO vulnerability_management.audit_log
  (workflow_name, execution_id, status, records_processed, error_message, executed_at)
VALUES ('workflow-correlation', '{{ $execution.id }}', 'SUCCESS', 0, 'No CPE matches found for {{ $json.processedCount }} processed CVEs.', NOW())

parameters.content:
## workflow-correlation

**Trigger:** POST webhook — llamado por workflow-collection al terminar, o manualmente.
**Lee:** `cves` (status=unprocessed, últimas 26h) + `software_inventory`
**Escribe:** `applicable_vulnerabilities`, `cves.status`, `audit_log`

### Algoritmo CPE Match (4 niveles)

| Nivel | Condición | Confidence |
|-------|-----------|------------|
| 1. Exact | `invUri === nvd.criteria` | HIGH |
| 2. Version range | Versión del activo dentro de `versionStart/EndIncluding/Excluding` | HIGH |
| 3. Wildcard | NVD tiene `version=*` o `version=-` | MEDIUM |
| 4. Heurístico | Vendor+product coinciden, versión difiere o no-semver | LOW |

### Notas
- CVEs sin `configurations` se saltan (no CPE = no correlación posible).
- `ON CONFLICT (cve_id, software_id) DO NOTHING` garantiza idempotencia.
- `status='correlated'` se setea incluso si no hubo matches (CVE intentado y descartado).
- Para llamar desde workflow-collection: HTTP POST a la webhook URL de este workflow.
